=Reduces the Confectance Index consumption of the active skill <color=#3487e0>Slaughter Sequence</color> by <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color>.
column2: Mengurangi pemakaian Confectance Index active skill <color=#3487e0>Slaughter Sequence</color> sebanyak <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color>.

column1: =At the start of action, if there are enemy units with <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> on the field, gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.

column1: =If there are no other allied units within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color> of the user, increases damage dealt by <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.
column2: Jika tidak ada unit sekutu lain <color=#f26c1c>dalam 3 tile</color> dari pengguna, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.

column1: =The active skill <color=#3487e0>Crushing Revolution</color> deals <color=#f26c1c>30%</color> increased damage when hitting a single target.
column2: Active skill <color=#3487e0>Crushing Revolution</color> memberikan damage <color=#f26c1c>30%</color> lebih besar saat mengenai satu target.

column1: =When the active skill <color=#3487e0>Quenching Slash</color> kills an enemy target, reduces this skill’s cooldown by <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.
column2: Jika active skill <color=#3487e0>Quenching Slash</color> membunuh target musuh, cooldown skill ini berkurang sebanyak <color=#f26c1c>2 giliran</color>.

column1: =If under the effects of a Burn buff, gains immunity to <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, and increases damage by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.

column1: =When the user has a Burn Buff, they gain immunity to <color=#3487e0>Frozen</color> and <color=#3487e0>Frigid</color>, and increases damage dealt by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.
column2: Saat pengguna memiliki Buff Burn, ia kebal terhadap <color=#3487e0>Frozen</color> dan <color=#3487e0>Frigid</color>, dan damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.
